name: AlRayan Bank (formerly Masraf Al Rayan)
founded: 2006 (incorporated 4 January 2006); merged with Al Khalij Commercial Bank (al khaliji) by absorption effective 30 Nov 2021; renamed from Masraf Al Rayan to AlRayan Bank
ownership_summary: QSE-listed with about 174k shareholders (126k outside Qatar). At 30 Jun 2026 the top holders were QIA 20.46%, the QAF investment portfolio 7.51% and a pension fund 5.36%. Government/GRE holders total 33.56% and Qatari ownership is 79.52% (Q2 2026 investor presentation).
government_link: Yes - QIA is the largest shareholder (20.46%) and Government/GRE holders total 33.56% at 30 Jun 2026 (S5). Deposits from Government/GRE are 51% and financing to Government/GRE 46% of the portfolio (S5).
group_structure: AlRayan Bank (Q.P.S.C.) is the QSE-listed Islamic parent. Subsidiaries (30 Jun 2026): Al Rayan Investment L.L.C. (ARI, 100%, QFC asset manager and corporate advisory, not profiled separately, so its AUM and people are recorded here with subsidiary scope); Al Rayan Bank PLC (UK Islamic bank, 73.91% after a GBP 50m capital increase in H1 2026, from 73.76%); Al Khaliji France S.A. (100%, conventional bank in Paris with 2 UAE branches, held at arm's length: its assets and liabilities are presented in other assets/liabilities and its profit is excluded from income); Al Rayan Partners L.L.C. (100%, real estate consulting, in liquidation); plus sukuk, financing and OTC hedging vehicles (MAR Sukuk Ltd, MAR Finance LLC, Lusail Waterfront Investment Co, Lusail Ltd, AKCB Markets Ltd). Associates (FY2025): National Real Estate Development and Investment SAOC (Oman, 21.48%), Sahb Finance, Beema (Damaan Islamic Insurance) and Linc.

footprint: Qatar: 13 branches (11 retail, 2 corporate) and 103-105 ATMs, with AlRayan GO self-service zones (S2, S4, S5). UK: Al Rayan Bank PLC (London). France and UAE: Al Khaliji France (Paris branch and 2 UAE branches). Second-largest listed Islamic bank in Qatar by assets (30% share) (S5).
customer_segments: Personal Banking covers Retail, AlRayan Premier (affluent: salary QAR 35k+ or QAR 1m+ deposit/financing) and Private Banking (HNW and affluent families). Wholesale covers government/GRE, corporate, commercial and SME. Treasury & FI covers institutions. ARI serves institutions, family offices, governments, pension funds and HNW individuals. The UK arm serves GCC-based Premier clients (especially Saudi Arabia) and real-estate borrowers.
business_lines: Five reportable segments: Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, Treasury and Financial Institutions, Asset Management (ARI: customised equity and fixed income solutions for institutional and HNW investors, mutual funds and an ETF, financial advisory) and International Operations (S2). Group business lines: Corporate & SME; Personal Banking (Retail, Premier and Private); Treasury & FI (primary dealer for QCB and IILM sukuk); Asset Management & Financial Advisory; International (UK, France, UAE) (S4). Retail investing: QSE trading via The Group's Sahl Plus link in the AlRayan GO app (May 2026).

capabilities.wealth_summary: AlRayan Bank is fully Islamic. Its wealth offer has two sides. The first is Personal Banking under GM Rana Al Asaad: AlRayan Premier for the affluent (salary QAR 35k+, or QAR 1m+ deposits or financing) and Private Banking with a Private Relationship Manager covering investment planning and asset management, credit, wealth protection and business planning (no product detail or threshold published). The second is the wholly owned Al Rayan Investment (ARI; QFCRA/QFMA), which had AUM of QAR 3.9bn at end-2025 across money markets, Gulf equities and sukuk. ARI runs segregated portfolios for institutions, family offices and HNW clients, a sukuk execution and custody service, and three funds, including the Al Rayan Qatar ETF (QATR, about QAR 460m) and the Al Rayan GCC Fund (over QAR 390m). Retail digital investing is limited: since 12 May 2026, Sahl Plus links the AlRayan GO app to client accounts at broker The Group for QSE trading and transfers. The LEAD strategy (2024-2027) targets growth in Private and Premier Banking through better segmentation and redefined propositions. Leadership is in transition: Group CEO Fahad Al Khalifa left on 30 Sep 2026, and Usman Ahmed (ex-NBB, ex-Citi Global Head of Islamic Banking) is appointed but not yet in post.

segments.name: AlRayan Premier
segments.eligibility: Monthly salary QR 35K or more; or deposit with ARB of QR 1 million or more and/or financing relationship starting at QR 1 million or more.

segments.name: AlRayan Private Banking
segments.eligibility: High net worth and affluent individuals and families; no threshold published. An invitation-only Al Qimma Visa Infinite Privilege card was launched in 2025.

private_banking.detail: Private Banking for HNW and affluent families, with a dedicated Private Relationship Manager and four areas: investment planning and asset management, credit planning and management, wealth protection, and business planning for private business owners. No products, platform or thresholds are published. The LEAD 2024-2027 strategy prioritises Private and Premier Banking. Al Rayan Bank UK also serves GCC-based Premier clients from London.

asset_management.detail: Al Rayan Investment L.L.C. (100%, est. 2007; QFCRA-authorised, QFMA-regulated; all products Shari'a-compliant). AUM was QAR 3.9bn at end-2025 across money markets, public equities and sukuk. All assets are managed in-house, with a GCC and Turkey focus. Products: segregated portfolios for governments, pension funds, corporates, family offices and HNW individuals; Al Rayan GCC Fund (over QAR 390m; -6% in 2025); Al Rayan Qatar ETF QATR (about QAR 460m market cap, TER 0.50%, tracks the QE Al Rayan Islamic Index); a third regulated fund; USD sukuk portfolios (about +9% net in 2025). Led by Acting CEO Akber Khan; Head of AM Zohaib Pervez.

brokerage.detail: No in-house broker. Sahl Plus (launched 12 May 2026 with The Group) lets customers link bank accounts to their investment accounts at The Group, trade on QSE and transfer funds within minutes through the AlRayan Bank mobile app. ARI offers a sukuk execution service to institutional and individual investors, with sukuk held in custody by ARI.

digital_investing.detail: AlRayan GO app (launched 9 Dec 2024; AI-avatar campaign May 2025; goal-based 'Pockets' savings). In-app investing is limited to QSE trading via The Group (Sahl Plus, May 2026). No in-app purchase of funds, sukuk or international equities was found. QATR can be bought on QSE.

advisory.detail: Private Banking gives investment planning and holistic financial analysis through relationship managers. ARI gives customised investment solutions and financial and strategic advisory.

discretionary.detail: ARI manages segregated portfolios ('bespoke solutions' by goal and risk tolerance) for institutions, family offices and HNW individuals. No retail discretionary product was found at the bank.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: No robo-advisor or model-portfolio product found on bank, ARI or app pages.

funds_platform.detail: Only ARI in-house funds (QATR, Al Rayan GCC Fund, third fund) were found; no third-party fund shelf or platform provider is published. Off-balance sheet AUM includes 'mutual funds and other securities' (S2), which may be client holdings.

structured_products.detail: Treasury lists structured deposits and hedging solutions among Shari'a-compliant treasury products. No investment-grade structured notes for wealth clients were found.

private_markets.detail: No private equity, private credit or real estate fund offer for clients found. ARI advises on IPOs, sukuk and M&A (corporate advisory, not client investment products).

islamic_wealth.detail: Whole group is Shari'a-compliant (AAOIFI). Products: Shari'a-compliant GCC equity/sukuk fund, the Islamic Qatar ETF (QATR), USD sukuk portfolios and sukuk execution.

opportunities: The LEAD strategy (2024-2027) explicitly targets upscaling personal banking, with a focus on Private and Premier Banking through better segmentation and redefined value propositions (S4 p.16).

Private Banking publishes no product shelf, platform or third-party funds. In-app investing is only QSE trading through a third-party broker (Sahl Plus, May 2026), and there are no model portfolios or in-app funds or sukuk (S7, S13).
The group has its own Shari'a-compliant manufacturer (ARI: QAR 3.9bn AUM, QATR, GCC Fund) but no evident digital distribution of ARI products to retail and premier clients (S4, S11).
A new Group CEO arrives in Q4 2026 with a Citi Islamic and retail background, and a new Group Chief Strategy and Technology Officer took over in May 2026 (S6, S16).
barriers: Fully Islamic (AAOIFI): every product must be Shari'a-compliant and approved by the Shari'a supervisory board (S2).
In-house asset manager (ARI) and broker partner (The Group) already cover local equities and sukuk (S11, S13).
CEO transition (Oct 2026) may delay vendor decisions until the new Group CEO is in post (S6).
incumbent_vendors: The Group Securities - QSE brokerage link (Sahl Plus) (S13)
